signal: EarthCam introduced Mobile StreamCam Robotic, an AI-powered robotic camera for interior construction, in October 2025

email.body1:
MaryKate, saw EarthCam just launched the Mobile StreamCam Robotic for interior jobsites.

A new AI product line usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover while reps learn the story, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EarthCam off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
MaryKate, quick follow-up for EarthCam.

A launch like the robotic camera creates a window where demand outpaces rep capacity. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert that interest, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EarthCam needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
MaryKate, last bit of proof for EarthCam.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EarthCam's reply rate likely compares to other construction-tech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
MaryKate, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a product launch, and I know rolling out a new camera line keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a construction-tech motion? I will tailor it to EarthCam either way.
